preview.tournamentOverview: Vidanta Vallarta is a par-71 layout that places a premium on approach play and around-the-green work. The course weights SG ATG at 6% and SG Total at 8%, rewarding players who scramble well and post consistent ball-striking numbers.
preview.modelExplainer: Our model leans heaviest on SG ATG 6%) and SG Total 8%), followed by SG OTT 6%) and SG APP 6%). Driving Accuracy 1%) and Bogey Avoidance 0%) carry smaller but meaningful weight, reflecting the course's emphasis on keeping the ball in play and minimizing big numbers. SG PUTT 4%) is de-emphasized, so putting variance is down-weighted in our rankings.
preview.pickApproach: We tier bets by model rank and power rank differential, targeting players inside the top 20 who also rank inside the top 50 in power rank. Emphasis is placed on SG ATG and SG Total edges, with secondary filters for SG APP and SG OTT.

article.title: VidantaWorld Mexico Open 2026: Model Ranks Lipsky, Yellamaraju, Putnam Ahead of Power
article.dek: Tournament model places David Lipsky at #1, Sudarshan Yellamaraju at #2, and Andrew Putnam at #3 for the 120-player field at Vidanta Vallarta.
article.introduction: The VidantaWorld Mexico Open model weights SG ATG at 6% and SG Total at 8%, elevating players who gain strokes around the green and overall. Lipsky, Yellamaraju, and Putnam occupy the top three tournament ranks despite power ranks of 24, 19, and 39 respectively. All three skipped the Scottish Open and carry zero tracked rounds in the major-swing workload column.

sections.heading: Tournament Overview
sections.body: The VidantaWorld Mexico Open at Vidanta Vallarta features a 120-player field and places the heaviest course weights on SG ATG 6%) and SG Total 8%). The model ranks players by a composite that includes SG OTT 6%), SG APP 6%), and SG PUT 4%).

sections.heading: Course Fit
sections.body: Lipsky posts 524 SG ATG and 485 SG Putt, aligning with the top two weighted categories. Yellamaraju leads the top-20 model with 34 SG Total and 616 SG Putt. Putnam records 515 SG ATG and 479 SG Total, both above the field average.

sections.heading: Recent Form
sections.body: Lipsky enters with a tournament rank of 1 and power rank of 24. Yellamaraju enters with a tournament rank of 2 and power rank of 19. Putnam enters with a tournament rank of 3 and power rank of 39.

sections.heading: Post-Open Workload
sections.body: All three players show NO_TRACKED_ROUNDS in the major-swing workload column. The classification indicates zero rounds recorded in the tracked events, not rest.

sections.heading: FedExCup Motivation
sections.body: Lipsky sits at FedExCup rank 85 in the CHASING_81_PLUS category. Yellamaraju sits at FedExCup rank 58 in the BUBBLE_51_80 category. Putnam sits at FedExCup rank 76 in the BUBBLE_51_80 category.

sections.heading: Crossover Research Angles
sections.body: Lipsky, Yellamaraju, and Putnam each skipped the Scottish Open and hold top-10 model ranks that sit well ahead of their power ranks. The model-to-power differential is 23 spots for Lipsky, 17 spots for Yellamaraju, and 36 spots for Putnam.

sections.heading: Outright Targets
sections.body: David Lipsky (model rank 1, power rank 24) and Sudarshan Yellamaraju (model rank 2, power rank 19) are the two outright targets. Both carry zero tracked rounds in the major-swing workload column and sit inside the top-25 power ranks.

sections.heading: Top-10 Targets
sections.body: David Lipsky (model rank 1), Sudarshan Yellamaraju (model rank 2), and Andrew Putnam (model rank 3) comprise the top-10 targets. All three post SG Total values between 479 and 34 and rank inside the top-40 power ranks.

sections.heading: Top-20 Targets
sections.body: David Lipsky (model rank 1), Sudarshan Yellamaraju (model rank 2), and Andrew Putnam (model rank 3) are the top-20 targets. Each player's tournament rank sits at least 17 spots ahead of his power rank.

sections.heading: Data Limitations

sections.heading: Final Betting Card
sections.body: Strong model-supported bets: David Lipsky (rank 1) and Sudarshan Yellamaraju (rank 2).

article.conclusion: Lipsky and Yellamaraju are the strong model-supported outright and top-10 plays; Putnam is the secondary top-20 target. All three carry zero tracked rounds in the major-swing workload column and sit well ahead of their power ranks in the tournament model.
